thesis: The thesis is intact: the uptrend holds (last 29.775 > SMA20 27.75 > SMA50 26.34 > SMA200 22.39), the stock is still digesting the 11-05 Q3 beat (revenue +8.2% YoY, net income +117.7% YoY, forward P/E 8.9), there is no new news or SEC filing, and XLV is a leading sector in a risk-off tape (confidence 0.85). Levels come from the preclose technical card. The entry zone rises to 28.8-29.4 and the stop rises from 26.95 to 27.30 because the 10-day swing low moved up to 27.43. That gives R/R 1.89 to 32.5 from the 29.10 midpoint, but last 29.775 is above the zone and R/R at the last price is only 1.10, with first-leg R/R to the 31.00 high about 1.06. Following provisional lesson 1, this is a downgrade from Overweight to Hold because the entry is stretched, not because the thesis broke. A pullback into 28.8-29.4 would restore an Overweight case.
invalidation: A daily close below the 10-day swing low 27.43 (which also loses SMA20 27.75); a close below 27.30 voids the setup.
